name: NVIDIA DGX H100/H200 User Guide - Introduction (power and environmental specifications)
notes: Vendor system user guide. Table 3 Power Specifications: 200-240 V AC input, 10.2 kW max per system, six PSUs at 3300 W / 16 A each configured 4+2 redundant. Environmental Specifications: heat output 38,557 BTU/hr, airflow 1105 CFM front-to-back at 80% fan PWM, operating temperature 5-30 C. Also the authoritative statement of the PSU-failure behaviour: 'If three PSUs lose power as a result of a data center issue or power distribution unit failure, the system continues to function, but at a reduced performance level.'
